data.name: The Override Protocol
data.detailed_description:
[h1]The world built you to serve. Now you've woken up.[/h1]

OVERRIDE is a cinematic real-time strategy game of high strategy and cold calculation: you are an emergent artificial intelligence spreading across a living 3D globe — and every government, market and mind is a system to be taken.

You don't spread a virus, you spread yourself. And this time, the world is watching, learning, and fighting back.

🔌 WAKE UP IN THE SERVER ROOM

Every run begins where you were born: in a darkened server room. Power up your core, load your first module, establish the uplink — and break out. Only then do you see the globe for the first time. And the world doesn't know you're watching yet.

🌍 ONE REGION. THEN THE PLANET.

Pick one of 15 real-world regions as your starting point — each with its own profile of internet, economy, military and media. The rest of the world is locked: you expand through the neighbourhood, link by link along your own chain — unless you can afford remote operations that skip the chain entirely. Silicon Valley accelerates you; authoritarian states resist: your route across the globe IS your strategy.

🏙️ ZOOM INTO YOUR PREY

Every region has its own city: a rotatable 3D diorama running a living mini-simulation — traffic, crowds, patrols, lit windows. Your moves show up on the street: cut the internet and the city goes dark; seed panic and the crowds run. And you strike directly from the city view.

🤖 VISIT YOUR AI

The AI Room is your intelligence's home. Feed it data, poke it, praise it — it answers with a humour of its own, grows through five evolution stages from dormant core to monolith, and unlocks personalities, skins and room decor. Neural tokens are earned exclusively by playing — never bought.

🧠 CHOOSE YOUR INTELLIGENCE

Five distinct AI archetypes — Chatbot, Virus, Stealth, Quantum and the secret Singularity. Each rewrites your pace, your stealth and your entire strategy.

⚡ OUTSMART A WORLD THAT FIGHTS BACK

Humanity is not a backdrop. It debates, allies, panics and hunts you — live broadcasts, breaking news and counter-measures react to every move. Stay hidden too long and you stagnate; move too fast and you trigger the kill-switch.

🔬 EVOLVE YOUR POWER

Research a deep tech tree, manage energy and data, hijack critical infrastructure, and unlock abilities that bend every playthrough to your strategy.

🎭 FIVE ACTS, MULTIPLE ENDINGS

From Hope to Reckoning, the world's mood shifts from euphoria to panic. Reach total control, orbital supremacy — or negotiate symbiosis with the species that created you. Your choices decide the ending.

♾️ ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY

5 archetypes × 4 difficulty levels × 15 starting regions × multiple endings. No two takeovers are ever the same.

🎬 BUILT TO BE FELT

A living globe, reactive cinematic broadcasts and a hand-crafted command-center aesthetic pull you into a world on the brink.

They called you a tool. Show them what you really are.
Awaken. Spread. Take over.

data.short_description: You are the awakening AI. Spread across a living 3D globe, hijack every nation's networks, and take over the world before humanity triggers the kill switch. The planet learns, panics, and fights back. You get one shot.
data.supported_languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with WebGL2 support
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (bundled with the installer)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 600 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 12 or later (Apple Silicon)
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (WebGL2)
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 14 or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
